summary: Implemented the authenticated seeker notification center with recipient-owned inbox pagination and filters, unread counts, localized safe projections, idempotent mark-read, and read-all transitions. Synchronized runtime integration, contracts, OpenAPI, Postman, inventory, documentation, and deterministic tests.

Syntax, contracts, and API typechecks passed.

Workspace, contracts, and API builds passed.
Synthetic non-production environment validation passed without reading a .env file.

sourceEvidence: apps/api/src/modules/notifications/service.ts enforces active seeker authorization, strict parsing, unread counts, and safe localized projections.
apps/api/src/modules/notifications/repository.ts scopes every read/write by recipientId, uses deterministic pagination/indexes, and excludes storage/internal fields.
apps/api/src/modules/notifications/router.ts defines GET inbox, POST owned read, and POST read-all routes behind seeker bearer authorization.

apps/api/tests/notifications/service.test.ts and router.test.ts cover positive, unauthenticated, unauthorized, invalid payload, ownership, replay, pagination/filter, localization, and safe-link behavior.
knownGaps: Live MongoDB replica-set smoke tests were not run because TEST_MONGODB_URI is unavailable; deterministic service/router tests and the repository adapter provide the safe empty-state boundary.
Production notification producers and seed data are not present; unprovisioned collections safely return an empty inbox and zero unread count without fabricated content.
The repository declares Node >=24 <25 while this environment provides Node 22.18.0; all available checks passed.
No security:check script is defined in the repository.
The task's notification-preference behavior is represented by bounded unread/type inbox filters; no additional unsupported preference route was invented beyond the canonical blueprint.
